newsitem.title: UK: Russia mark Eurobond seen at 350-370 b.p. spread.
newsitem.headline: Russia mark Eurobond seen at 350-370 b.p. spread.

text.p: Russia's debut mark Eurobond, due for launch on Thursday, was likely to be priced to yield between 350 and 370 basis points over Bunds, bankers said on Wednesday.

Officials at joint lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said earlier the deal would have a seven-year maturity and would be for at least 1.5 billion marks and be launched on Thursday. They declined to comment on the pricing of the issue.
"The launch spread is expected between 350 to 370 b.p. over Bunds, and the deal could be for up to 2.0 billion marks," a syndicate manager at a European bank said.
Seven-year German government debt at 1147 GMT was yielding 5.27 percent.
When marketing for the issue began a few weeks ago, spread talk was between 320 and 340 b.p. over, dealers said.
"The higher indicated spread reflects the fact the market has fallen," a banker familiar with the Russian deal said.
Spreads on emerging market bonds have widened sharply in the last two weeks amid concerns U.S. interest rates might rise.
